verdict.rationale: An API gateway/proxy like LiteLLM could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, so the axis applies. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on the docs site returning 404, and no evidence item documents a downloadable machine-readable spec. OpenAI-format compatibility and llms.txt are adjacent features, not a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
